name: Bob Ray
background: Bob Ray lives in Cheyenne, Laramie County. He was unopposed in the Aug. 20, 2024 Democratic primary for House District 42 and lost the Nov. 5, 2024 general election.
No public occupation, education, or military record was found in the sources reviewed for this fill. He did not submit a biographical answer to the 2024 WyoFile Election Guide questionnaire.
